mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at Badger Prairie County Park, a Waxing Gibbous moon, and a prime view of the International Space Station passing from the Cross Plains area toward the Costco in Oregon starting at 9:35 PM. The overnight low will hit 57 degrees with no rain expected.

The city has closed the entry period for the I Voted sticker contest for K-12 students, with community voting scheduled to open on July 28 and run through August 7. Additionally, the Public Works department reminds residents to inspect their mailboxes ahead of the winter season to ensure they meet USPS specifications and can withstand snow removal operations.

We have plenty of fun scheduled, including Yoga at Insight Wellness today, the free Concerts in the Park event today, and Hop Haus Trivia this evening. Tomorrow, you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard or Wisconsin Brewing Company.

In a report covering July 13 through July 20, officers handled a variety of calls. On July 16, a traffic stop for expired registration led to the arrest of a driver who had an outstanding warrant and was found to be in possession of marijuana and drug paraphernalia.
Today is the perfect day to stop by Culver's for the Really Reese's flavor of the day. They are open until 10 PM tonight, so you have plenty of time to grab a scoop before they close.
